GeneDef.label: herbivore
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a strict herbivorous diet. They can't eat and digest meat unless it is cooked in a meal.

GeneDef.label: carnivore
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a strict carnivorous diet. They can't eat and digest fruits or vegetables unless they are cooked in a meal.

GeneDef.label: omnivore
GeneDef.description: Carrier of this gene have a standard omnivorous diet, common to most intelligent races.
